insights.title: Input handling spawns processes on 2 interaction types
insights.detail: Hover, focus and click should be fork-free (a fork costs ~1 ms, an awk ~4 ms). Command palette open: 3.0 forks + 1.0 programs; Mouse click: 1.0 forks + 0.2 programs.

insights.title: Page switch, revisit is over budget
insights.detail: Page switch, revisit takes 220 ms (budget 100 ms, 2.2×). 17% of it runs in Subprocesses.

insights.title: Page switch by key (alt+2) is over budget
insights.detail: Page switch by key (alt+2) takes 249 ms (budget 100 ms, 2.5×). 19% of it runs in Subprocesses.

insights.title: Page switch, first visit: 11 forks + 4 external programs per action (~15 ms in programs)
insights.detail: Processes spawned while switching pages or resizing; each one is wall-clock the user waits for.
